disclosures.subject: pd33 supersession (D1 resolved as an instrument property)
disclosures.detail: The three pd33 refusals are A5_NATIVE_ADMISSION_UNAVAILABLE because that composition mounts the governed realm but no `teamToolPlane`; after #730 the native bash's admission edge is published only by a plane mount (agent-bindings.mjs:3135/:3144/:3390), and INSTALL.md §3.5 (lines 521-524) makes 'no plane = typed-shut' an explicit installation rule. The driver now carries a dated SUPERSEDED_BASH_ARM block naming #730/#734, the token, the three case ids and the two successor instruments, and keeps failing the run (RESULT FAIL, 16/19) instead of softening the cases. I sign the conclusion that this is an instrument/composition limit, not a governance regression, on that evidence. The claim I do NOT make: that the A5-only composition still runs governed bash; it does not, by design.

disclosures.subject: PD33-SUPERSEDED pin is a source-text tripwire, not a composition assertion
disclosures.detail: It asserts `doesNotMatch(DRIVER, /teamToolPlane\s*:/)` and `doesNotMatch(DRIVER, /capabilities:\s*\{[^}]*permissions/)`. A computed-key mount (`[ 'teamToolPlane' ]: plane`), a spread, or a multi-line capabilities block evades both — demonstrated by a host-free probe (attacks/ pin-probe.log). It stops the obvious silent mount; it does not prove the emitted composition has no plane.

The blueprint identity is established here from the boot artifacts (a1-a6off-run{1,2} and a1-a6on), not from the print-composition output the remedy's README cites.

verdict: NOT PASS (candidate claim not eligible from this record)
verdictBasis: The A6-off remedy is real where it was measured: 7/7 twice, legacy Leader lane, no Officer wake, identical blueprint document, and the same-result flip is only two emitted lines (S1, S2); #738 holds (S3); the pd33 supersession is code-backed and disclosed rather than papered over (S4); packaging is clean and identical (S5). It is still not enough to sign a release claim. PD-40 Sticky Stop REPRODUCES (R3), so 'durable Sticky Stop' stays refused. The weakest remaining claim is R1: 'A6-off is a zero-regression toggle'. Its only measurement is the seven A1 clauses in one composition; Goal ∧ plane-takeover ∧ A6-off has no instrument at all (D3), PD-42's approved-bash-out-of-lane has none (D4), and the operator re-issue path has none (R6). Two further erosion findings: the remedy's own committed artifacts do not support its README (A9/R7), and the release notes still assert PD-43 open in four places even though the register is fixed (A10/R5). No product edit was made; no Authority or candidate ref moved.
